items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Let’s move to these early Blue Note sessions. So Alfred Lion approaches you at Minton’s, or maybe Ike Quebec, we’re not quite clear... But one way or the other, you go in the studio for the first time, at least as recorded in the discographies, on April 7, 1952, with Milt Jackson, John Lewis, Kenny Clarke, and...
Percy Heath on bass. What was that date like?
